top_signals.title: US Market Breadth Shows Historically Narrow Reading
top_signals.summary:
A rally in oil prices spurred renewed bond volatility and drove stocks lower, with the market extending losses after data showed factories are contending with inflationary pressures.
Liz Ann Sonders, Chief Investment Strategist at Charles Schwab, talks about her market outlook and staying invested amid 2H volatility. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
